note: Declared world-quality gate for generation attempts. Only these codes are retried with a derived seed; anything else (producer refusal, mechanical failure, source parser error, compiler or engine limitation) fails the generation immediately. Thresholds are the diagnostic campaign's minimum: two cities with ports. The four travel codes come from the static travel gate (MMR-28, worldgen/policies/playability.json), which runs when a request binds playability and the campaign compiler policies.
